scope: Existing HS ability to modify supplied sources and connections beyond authored device cases.
method: Read production entrypoints and run fresh changed-input probes; native board and helper-board readback; explicitly separate logical plans from native artifacts.
conclusion: Reusable board-editing, module rewiring, source-bound wiring checks and specialized keyboard reconstruction exist. Generality is limited by lossy lowering, disconnected source/edit stores, specialized geometry and incomplete cross-domain revision execution.

observed_capabilities.user_change: Move and rotate components in a supplied published board
observed_capabilities.execution: Production candidate REST API on KiCad9.0.2 PIC programmer demo, independent native pcbnew readback.
observed_capabilities.observed: Two requested component changes retained all63 footprints,370 straight tracks,6 vias, original pad/net mappings and unrelated geometry. Native DRC reported10 additional violations; candidate stayed pending and original saved revision remained unchanged.
observed_capabilities.limit: Existing copper is not rerouted by footprint movement; checks run without donor project-rule sidecars.

observed_capabilities.observed: Generated BME280 I2C connections changed GPIO21/GPIO22 to GP4/GP5 and retained six wires.
observed_capabilities.limit: Known catalog modules; bounded ERC, no compiled firmware or physical behavior established.

observed_capabilities.user_change: Adapt a 5V sensor to a 3.3V controller
observed_capabilities.observed: Direct wiring produced two voltage errors. An explicitly supplied level-shifter module generated12 wires via LV/HV interfaces and passed bounded ERC.
observed_capabilities.limit: This proves execution of an explicitly specified adaptation; it does not prove autonomous discovery of the right adapter.

observed_capabilities.user_change: Change a keyboard cut and selected key
observed_capabilities.observed: Explicit helper inputs cutX107mm and SW4 produced source-bound MX daughterboard/interposer with original ROW_0/COL_3 mappings and clean native DRC. Forged live-pad cut and cross-net bridge rejected.
observed_capabilities.limit: Two-layer/switch-board specialization; cut halves simulated as islands; add-on PCBs emitted. Destination is fixed24mm-pitch MX row; CLI --x only assesses requested cut while repair chooses scanned/automatic route.

material_gaps.gap: Fresh netlist compilation can lose exact package and electrical identity
material_gaps.evidence: Unfamiliar QFN/SOIC/keyed-package requests yielded the same generic through-hole local pad layout; source reference/pad/net labels replaced. Bodies, placement and copper can still differ. No fallback warning appeared in geometry output.
material_gaps.scope: Observed production lowering/geometry generation; final native compilation/readiness not evaluated.

material_gaps.gap: Uploaded source inspection is not automatically editable-source promotion
material_gaps.evidence: Upload writes engineeringSources; candidate editing reads retained artifacts from a build-directory pin. No general promotion bridge found.

material_gaps.gap: Unknown catalog IDs may be omitted
material_gaps.evidence: Direct auto-wire helper filtered unknown donor ID without warning.
material_gaps.scope: Direct helper probe; downstream request-fidelity logic may reject the mismatch.

material_gaps.gap: Circuit import does not automatically establish arbitrary electrical ratings
material_gaps.evidence: Custom voltage-limit fields did not populate canonical contract fields in the fresh projection probe.

STEP inspection and declared clearance/fastener checks are broader than source editing. Carrier generation is a fixed rectangular envelope without mounting holes; MultiCAD authoring supports boxes/cylinders.

material_gaps.gap: Whole-project changes do not propagate through all artifacts
material_gaps.evidence: AI project compose action forwards a narrower input set than compose_dispatch supports and does not expose generic native/electrical candidate edits. No complete connector-move -> copper/wiring/enclosure/firmware regeneration loop found.

fix_completed.problem: Native curved copper was silently replaced by its endpoint chord in keyboard cut/topology extraction, allowing a missed real cut intersection.
fix_completed.change: Reject unsupported PCB_ARC before endpoint conversion; generic KiCad import/edit paths remain separate.
fix_completed.native_regression: Derived actual PCB_ARC with midpoint5mm off its endpoint chord is explicitly rejected; no usable extraction emitted.
